name: series-forge-studio
description: Estudio audiovisual local file-first: personajes procedurales toon 3D, animación determinista, voces offline, lip-sync y exportación MP4 por agentes

scripts.test: node --test --test-timeout=600000 tests/engine.test.ts tests/project.test.ts tests/story.test.ts tests/audio.test.ts tests/pipeline.test.ts tests/ui.test.ts tests/workspace.test.mjs tests/render.test.mjs tests/studio.test.mjs tests/live-assets.test.mjs tests/three-pipeline.test.mjs
scripts.pilot: node src/cli/studio.ts init pilot --force && node src/cli/studio.ts produce el-ultimo-turno ep-001
